discoveries.title: No authorized original specification is in the repository
discoveries.description: The compatibility matrix and its provenance file describe this repository. They are not an official Rules of Survival dataset.
discoveries.observed_fact: testdata/reference/provenance.json says the compatibility matrix was written from inspection of this repository and is not an official Rules of Survival reference.
discoveries.interpretation: Local implementation and local tests cannot be promoted to original-game compatibility.
discoveries.hypothesis: An authorized specification may exist outside this repository. None is checked in here.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Every feature stays compatibility_status unknown until a new source and a comparison are recorded.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The provenance file labels the matrix, the synthetic player, and the solo scenario as local artifacts.

discoveries.title: Development uses SQLite and production settings expect PostgreSQL
discoveries.description: The README and operations document describe two database targets. The PostgreSQL test was skipped.
discoveries.observed_fact: README.md says development uses SQLite. docker-compose.yml defines PostgreSQL and Redis. RO-008 and RO-028 record that test_postgres_account_roundtrip was skipped because POSTGRES_TEST_URL was unset.
discoveries.interpretation: Schema portability is intended. A skipped PostgreSQL test is not evidence that production PostgreSQL was executed.
discoveries.hypothesis: The same Alembic revision will run on PostgreSQL. That still needs a run with POSTGRES_TEST_URL set.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not claim a PostgreSQL verification. Do not downgrade a database that must be kept.
discoveries.observed_behavior: Startup applies alembic upgrade head to the SQLite file in DATABASE_URL. Compose was not started in RO-010.

discoveries.title: The wire protocol is this server's JSON protocol
discoveries.description: README.md and the architecture decision record describe a project JSON protocol, not an official client protocol.
discoveries.observed_fact: README.md documents version 1 messages auth, lobby.join, player.action, player.input, and state on ws://<host>:8000/api/v1/ws. The architecture record says this is not an official Rules of Survival client protocol.
discoveries.interpretation: Protocol tests prove this server's contract. They do not prove that an original game client can connect.
discoveries.hypothesis: The original client uses a different interface. That interface is not in this repository.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Networking work must keep rejecting unknown versions and must not be described as official-client compatibility.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The first WebSocket message carries the token in the payload. The token is not placed in the URL.

discoveries.title: Migration 93510e8bf194 preserves legacy_players
discoveries.description: The accepted architecture record says the initial revision renames the old players table and does not drop it on upgrade.
discoveries.observed_fact: docs/engineering/ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md states that revision 93510e8bf194 renames players to legacy_players, copies rows, and does not drop the legacy table on upgrade.
discoveries.interpretation: Upgrade is the path for an existing development database. Downgrade is documented for a disposable database.
discoveries.hypothesis: None. The preservation rule is already an accepted decision. RO-009 still has to cite the migration file in a security review.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not rewrite revision 93510e8bf194. Do not delete legacy_players or player-owned rows.
discoveries.observed_behavior: Upgrade keeps the renamed legacy table. Downgrade drops the new tables and is limited to a disposable database.

discoveries.title: Original combat, equipment, and vehicle behavior is unknown
discoveries.description: The matrix records local weapon and movement rules and leaves original behavior unknown. Equipment and vehicles are not implemented.
discoveries.observed_fact: The compatibility matrix marks GP-002, GP-004, and GP-005 as implemented local behavior with compatibility unknown. GP-007 and GP-008 are not implemented. Provenance says the solo scenario expects pistol damage 22 and speed 5 from this server's own files.
discoveries.interpretation: Those numbers are a local contract. They are not an original weapon table.
discoveries.hypothesis: The commercial game has different weapon, vehicle, and equipment behavior. No authorized source for those values is in this repository.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not fill equipment or vehicles with guessed original stats. Tests must cite app/game/items.py and app/game/rules.py when they assert local numbers.
discoveries.observed_behavior: Local health starts at 100 in the matrix notes. Local speed is 5 map units per second. No vehicle simulation is implemented.

discoveries.title: No authorized client build is stored in the repository
discoveries.description: A search of the workspace found no APK, IPA, packet capture, or native library that could be used as a client reference.
discoveries.observed_fact: The workspace contains no .apk, .ipa, .pcap, or .so file. README.md describes a browser client at /play for this server.
discoveries.interpretation: There is a browser play page for this server. There is no checked-in original mobile client to compare against.
discoveries.hypothesis: A user-owned authorized client may be analyzed later under the research rules. That analysis has not started.
discoveries.implementation_impact: Do not claim the original client can connect. Do not bypass pinning or authentication to obtain a client interface.
discoveries.observed_behavior: The documented client path is the browser page served by this server, using this server's WebSocket messages.
